meta.ref: local working copy on ca87b3e (2026-10-04) with uncommitted changes up to 2026-10-09

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The brand orange (Elementor global Primary; `--gads-orange` and `--about-orange` in the page CSS). Fills: filled buttons, process-step cards, the highlight chip behind heading words, the checklist panel, the active language and the back-to-top button. Also icons, card titles, eyebrows, the display H1 and orange H2s on `white`. Contrast is 2.4:1 against `white` in both directions, under the WCAG AA floor even for large text (3:1); `ink` on `orange` reads 6.1:1.

tokens.name: orange-logo
tokens.usage: The orange of the logo blob. Also: header menu text on hover, the mobile-menu dividers, the first stop of the CTA gradients, and (at 89% alpha, #ff6c2ae3) the header button 'Ai o idee?'. 2.8:1 on `white`: a fill, not a text colour.

tokens.name: orange-light
tokens.usage: Light end of the orange gradients: the contact section (135deg, `orange-light` to `orange-hot`) and the Logo design CTA band (`orange-logo`, `orange` at 45%, `orange-light`). `white` text on it reads 2.1:1.

tokens.name: orange-hot
tokens.usage: Dark end of the contact-section gradient, and the label colour of white buttons placed on orange bands (`ect-btn--on-brand`). 3.2:1 on `white`: enough only for text 24px+ or bold 19px+, so the 16px/600 labels that use it fall short.

tokens.name: orange-border
tokens.usage: The 2px border of the header button 'Ai o idee?'. Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: The darkest orange in use: header submenu text on hover and the 2px focus outline in the header menu. The only orange that passes as small text: 5.9:1 on `white`, 5.4:1 on `peach-menu`, 5.3:1 on `peach`.

tokens.name: orange-check
tokens.usage: Check marks in the Google Ads price lists. 6.0:1 on `white`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text everywhere (Elementor global Text; `--gads-ink`, `--about-ink`): headings, body copy, input text, footer links. 14.9:1 on `white`, 14.1:1 on `surface-soft`, 13.3:1 on `peach`, 6.1:1 on `orange`. Also the 3px focus outline on the Google Ads page and the homepage process chart.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the Google Ads page (`--gads-muted`): kickers, card numbers, price notes, FAQ numbers. 7.4:1 on `white`, 7.0:1 on `surface-soft`, 6.6:1 on `peach`.

tokens.name: ink-75
tokens.usage: `ink` at 75%: the footnote under the homepage process chart. 6.5:1 on `white`.

tokens.name: ink-10
tokens.usage: `ink` at 10%: the lane rules of the homepage process chart and the dividers in the About values list. Decorative only, never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Header menu links and submenu items at rest. 5.9:1 on `white`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Elementor global Accent (grey teal): hover colour of the footer social icons and a few small kicker lines on the older service pages; also the Elementor default button and menu-hover colour, which the live pages override. 5.0:1 on `white`.

tokens.name: warm-gray
tokens.usage: Checkbox outlines and the dotted handles in the homepage checklist rows. 5.2:1 on `white`.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background (the Elementor kit body colour), cards, the form card, outline buttons, the language switch. Text colour on `orange` and on the CTA gradients (see the contrast note on `orange`).

tokens.name: white-warm
tokens.usage: Elementor global for the labels of filled orange buttons and the back-to-top arrow. Reads as `white`.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Elementor global (light grey) behind the soft sections of the Google Ads page.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill and border of the contact-form inputs. 1.03:1 against the `white` form card, so the field edges are practically invisible (WCAG asks 3:1 for input boundaries).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Warm tint on the Google Ads page: number circles, the pressed state of buttons, the header band of price cards, the open FAQ toggle.

tokens.name: peach-phase
tokens.usage: Phase labels above the homepage process chart.

tokens.name: peach-menu
tokens.usage: Background of a hovered or focused header submenu item.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Speech bubbles on the homepage checklist band; `ink` on it reads 13.8:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Elementor global (light grey) hairlines: footer top rule, FAQ and price-list dividers, budget-card borders (`--gads-line`). Decorative: 1.2:1 against `white`.

tokens.name: line-peach
tokens.usage: Borders of the homepage checklist rows.

tokens.name: line-menu
tokens.usage: Border of the header submenu card.

tokens.name: line-faq
tokens.usage: Outline of the round +/- toggle in the Google Ads FAQ. 1.4:1 on `white`, under the 3:1 a control boundary needs.

tokens.name: line-step
tokens.usage: Vertical connector between the numbered steps on mobile (Google Ads, 'Procesul nostru').

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: Elementor global Secondary. Not used for UI text or fills on the current pages; the brand's turquoise lives in the pale blob backgrounds (`blob-turquoise`) and the mascot illustrations. 1.4:1 on `white`: never text.

tokens.name: blob-turquoise
tokens.usage: The hero blob (daycare-hero-bg.png: #8ae0e5 at 24% over white). Background art only; `ink` on it reads 13.5:1.

tokens.name: blob-turquoise-deep
tokens.usage: Where two hero blobs overlap (two 24% layers). Background art only.

tokens.name: blob-lavender
tokens.usage: The lavender blob in the homepage and About background sheets. Background art only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Contact-form status text after a message is accepted (`.ect-contact-status[data-state=success]`), on `success-soft`: 6.8:1. The message text says what happened; colour is never the only signal.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the success status message.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Contact-form error text and border (`data-state=error`), on `danger-soft`: 7.4:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the error status message.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Contact-form 'sending' text and border (`data-state=sending`), on `info-soft`: 9.9:1.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the sending status message.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Montserrat only. On screen the Elementor pages and the About page capitalise every word of H2 and H3 (text-transform: capitalize) and set the display H1 in capitals; the Google Ads page and the checklist band keep sentence case. Sizes are desktop.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: AGENȚIE DE MARKETING ONLINE ÎN BUCUREȘTI
styles.usage: Hero H1, uppercase, in `orange`. 38px on tablet; 9.9vw on mobile (About) or clamp(37px, 4vw, 45px) (Logo design).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles in `ink` or `orange`. 32px/38.4px on tablet, 7.5vw on mobile.

styles.name: checklist-title
styles.sample: Promovarea n-ar trebui să arate ca o listă care nu se mai termină
styles.usage: Only the homepage checklist band: `white` on `orange`, sentence case, clamp(32px, 3.2vw, 44px).

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price figures in the price cards.

styles.name: contact-title
styles.sample: Te putem ajuta, indiferent de orașul din care ne scrii.
styles.usage: Contact-section headline in `white`, key words in bold. 30px on tablet and mobile.

styles.name: cta-title
styles.sample: Următorul proiect poate fi al tău
styles.usage: Titles of CTA bands and panels, `white` on the orange gradient. 26 to 28px on mobile.

styles.name: h3-lg
styles.sample: Ce Îți Oferă Un Site De Prezentare
styles.usage: Sub-section titles on the service pages, in `orange`.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Names of price cards and packages.

styles.name: form-title
styles.usage: Title of the contact-form card, `ink`. 19px on mobile.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles: `orange` on the homepage service cards and About, `ink` on the Google Ads page (21 to 22px there).

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Titles inside process-step cards, `white` on `orange`.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body weight is 300, which is thin at 15px; the step cards switch to 400 on orange for that reason.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The label line above a hero H1, in `ink`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above a section H2, in `orange`. 16px on mobile.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Ne plac întrebările grele, ideile curajoase și lucrurile făcute cum trebuie.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero or section title. 16px/22.4px on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Suntem nerdy și suntem pricepuți. O agenție de marketing digital din București, pentru promovarea online de care chiar ai nevoie, nu pentru cea din broșuri.
styles.usage: All running text (Elementor global Text: Montserrat 16px, 1.4em, 300). 15px on tablet and mobile.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Chips, notes and footer details; step-card bodies use 400 because they sit on `orange`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Filled buttons and the form submit (Elementor global Accent: Montserrat 16px, 1.2em, 500, capitalised).

styles.name: button-strong
styles.usage: Outline buttons. The homepage hero button uses 18px/21.6px.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header menu items, `slate`, capitalised.

styles.name: link
styles.sample: Vezi ce ne iese când lucrăm împreună
styles.usage: Underlined text links and the band CTA.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Consultație gratuită · 30 de minute · Fără obligații
styles.usage: CTA notes, the footer copyright, card text and price-list items on the Google Ads page.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Bugetul de publicitate se plătește separat către Google.
styles.usage: Notes under buttons and prices, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The language switch, in `orange` (or `white` on the active language).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: FAQ numbers and sub-labels of the contents bar on the Google Ads page, in `ink-muted`. The smallest size on the site.

groups.name: Handwritten
groups.note: Caveat (SIL Open Font License), subset to ASCII and Romanian. One short aside per section, rotated a few degrees.

styles.name: scribble
styles.usage: Hand-written aside beside a section header (homepage), `ink`, rotated -7deg. 14px for the mobile swipe hint.

styles.name: scribble-lg
styles.usage: Hand-written line in the About story, rotated -3deg; the About hero note is 25px at -4deg.

groups.name: Header button
groups.note: The only text on the site not set in Montserrat.

styles.name: button-cta
styles.usage: The header button only.

spacing.note: There is no fixed scale in the code; these are the steps the pages repeat. Section padding also appears as 58/85px (Google Ads) and 70/84px (homepage process).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Elementor container default padding (kit); gap inside chips and icon rows; eyebrow bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon-box icon and its title; between homepage FAQ items; between stacked measurement cards.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Elementor widget spacing (kit `--widgets-spacing`); the page side gutter (padding-inline 20px); feature-card gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card grid gap (About principles, Google Ads features on desktop); gap inside the band; CTA grid gap.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Team-card grid gap; card padding on tablet and mobile (About).

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Card grid gap (Logo design); padding of the contact-form card; horizontal padding of outline buttons.

tokens.name: space-50
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; footer top padding.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (`ect-section`, About).

tokens.name: space-120
tokens.usage: Top padding of the contact section and the Logo design hero on desktop.

radius.note: The signature shape is the leaf card: three 15px corners and one big bottom-left corner. Write it as border-radius: var(--radius-card) var(--radius-card) var(--radius-card) var(--radius-leaf).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Rows of the homepage checklist.

tokens.name: radius-status
tokens.usage: Contact-form status message.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Header submenu card.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Three corners of every leaf card; chips, form fields, budget cards, the highlight chip, process phase labels.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The checklist panel and its speech bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons (a pill at their height); the contact-form card and the About CTA panel.

tokens.name: radius-leaf-sm
tokens.usage: Bottom-left corner of the smaller leaf cards: process steps, measurement cards, the band on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-leaf
tokens.usage: Bottom-left corner of the leaf card: service, feature, price and specialty cards and the maintenance band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The language switch. The header button (60px) and back-to-top (200px) are fully round at their size too.

shadow.note: Shadows are soft glows with no offset, so cards look lit from all sides.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards, chips, process steps and the band: the most used shadow on the site.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus-within on interactive cards, together with a 10px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-toggle
tokens.usage: The homepage FAQ items (Elementor toggle).

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The About CTA panel; hover on the price boxes of the website-design page.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-strong
tokens.usage: The back-to-top button.

tokens.name: shadow-featured
tokens.usage: The featured price card.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: The header submenu.

tokens.name: shadow-switch
tokens.usage: The language switch.

tokens.name: shadow-bubble
tokens.usage: Speech bubbles; the site applies it as filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(100, 48, 25, 0.16)).

layout.note: Content widths and the breakpoints the code uses. Elementor switches at 767px and 1024px; the hand-built sections also use 600, 640, 960 and 1100px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Content width of the hand-built sections (`ect-container`, the homepage process, About).

tokens.name: contact-max
tokens.usage: Content width of the contact section.

tokens.name: ads-max
tokens.usage: Content width on the Google Ads page: min(1280px, 100% - 40px), 64px of gutter from 640px.

tokens.name: section-max
tokens.usage: Elementor boxed sections and containers (kit maximum).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header minimum height; the logo sits in it 80px wide and 75px tall.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target: menu items, the burger, the language switch, FAQ toggles, text buttons.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: Elementor mobile breakpoint (max-width).

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Elementor tablet breakpoint (max-width); desktop starts at 1025px.
